## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
      and `cargo test --locked` are green
- [ ] Tests added that fail before this change and pass after it
- [ ] `docs/clocx.md` (and the README, if affected) updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] A fragment added in `changelog.d/` for user-visible changes
- [ ] Commit messages follow the `<type>(<scope>): <imperative summary>`
      format described in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] ASCII only (no emojis, no smart quotes, no em dashes)
- [ ] AI assistance: none / <tool>, <how used> (drafted / reviewed / tests written)
- [ ] I understand and can explain every line of this change
